messages:
Maria (AE): Hi team — Enterprise POC with FinCorp hitting lots of 429s during bulk document ingest. Demo scheduled tomorrow, can we triage?
Chris (SalesEng): Ugh. Are these 429s from per-tenant quota or per-route caps? Any logs from their side?
Maria (AE): Customer sent this snippet from their client: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` and `x-redwood-retry-after: 3` repeatedly. They upload ~2k docs in parallel batches of 50.
Samira (Infra): @Chris can you share the tenant id? I can look up server-side throttle metrics.
Chris (SalesEng): Tenant: fincorp-demo-72. Sending access details over DM.
Alex (SRE): Quick check: on our side I see sustained spikes and a lot of per-route rejections for `/v1/generate` and `/v1/embeddings`. Token accounting shows bursts beyond the configured per-route token_budget.
Maria (AE): They said they expected per-tenant burst window to allow short spikes — this is a POC, they need short bursts for indexing.
Chris (SalesEng): Current config for that tenant: global quota OK, per-route cap = 100 concurrent requests, token_budget = 60000 per minute, burst_window = 10s. Their workload fires many concurrent requests with long sequences — token use spikes.
Samira (Infra): Two immediate options: 1) temporarily bump per-route concurrency to 200 for the tenant; 2) add a per-tenant short-burst allowance (extra tokens for 30s).
Alex (SRE): Also recommend enabling prefix KV cache for their indexing flow — most documents share overlapping context so it saves tokens.
Maria (AE): Customer asked about pricing impact if we bump the cap. Need quick estimate to share with them.
Chris (SalesEng): Rough calc: extra 100 concurrent for ~30 minutes at avg 600 tokens/request = ~100 * 30min * (requests/min). Let's be conservative: estimate +$45 for the temporary bump. I'll send exact numbers after Samira confirms.
Samira (Infra): I can apply a temporary override. Applying now and will monitor logs for 5m. @quota-bot please apply override: tenant=fincorp-demo-72, per_route_concurrency=200, burst_extra_tokens=120000, duration=30m
quota-bot: override accepted. change_id=ovr-2026-0034
Alex (SRE): Seeing drop in 429s already. Errors down from 18% -> ~1.2%. Latency stable.
Maria (AE): Awesome. Customer can continue the demo flow. Please keep it on for the 30m and then auto-revert.
Chris (SalesEng): FYI — I'm logging this as a follow-up ask: add a documented POC temporary override playbook for Sales so we don't scramble next time.
Samira (Infra): Filing RFC in infra backlog. Also adding a config suggestion: reduce default per-route token charge for embedding calls when batching >= 16.
Maria (AE): Customer also asked for a short note we can send to fincorp explaining why 429s happened and what we changed. Can someone draft 2-3 lines?
Chris (SalesEng): Draft: "We saw your indexing traffic produce short token bursts that exceeded the tenant's per-route burst budget, triggering automated 429 throttles. We've temporarily increased the per-route concurrency and granted extra burst tokens for 30 minutes to complete your demo; this will revert automatically. For production, we recommend pacing ingestion or enabling KV prefix caching and a reserved Dedicated pool to avoid throttles."
Maria (AE): Perfect — I'll send that. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Alex (SRE): One more note — we'll add a short-term alert for repeated 429s tied to POC tenants so SRE can proactively ping SalesEng next time.
Maria (AE): Closing the loop: demo went well, no further 429s. Please keep the follow-ups in backlog.
Chris (SalesEng): Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
